app: isolated packaged macOS App with its own Core and data directory
runtimeFixtureScope: Controlled ACP frames through a temporary ROVAI_QWEN_BIN override; not evidence of Qwen Provider Usage or Context support

run.streamPattern: 14 text increments at 500 ms, tool call and 6000 ms silence, 10 text increments at 500 ms, terminal marker

expectation.midstreamOpen: Prior text establishes a hidden baseline; only new text can produce speed after warmup
expectation.liveDisplay: Speed appears in the member header beside the context ring; the running card keeps duration; speed updates at most once per second
expectation.toolPause: Speed disappears after five seconds with no new public text
expectation.resume: Speed restarts from new public text
expectation.history: Opening a historical Run card does not change the active Run speed in the member header
expectation.terminal: The current speed disappears immediately; a terminal card with no Usage shows a duration clock
expectation.lateUsage: A summary written after terminal replaces the clock with a token entry, whose popover shows four Usage buckets and duration

lateUsageMethod: After the real controlled Run reached succeeded, the acceptance script updated its existing empty runtime_usage_run_summary row. The App stayed open and its monitoring.execution terminal poll read the row. This tests the read and Renderer race, not native Qwen Usage emission.
